general.pageSubtitle: Language, appearance, and EdgePilot visual material.
general.languageDescription: Automatic follows the system language when available. Installed languages are discovered from the translation files included with the app.
general.themeDescription: Choose whether Settings follows the system or always uses light or dark mode. The notch keeps its dedicated EdgePilot visual style.
edge.pageSubtitle: Choose where EdgePilot appears and how the panel behaves at the screen edge.
edge.positionDescription: The preview follows your selection and shows where the tab will appear.
edge.positionHint: Choose the edge EdgePilot should emerge from.
edge.behaviorDescription: On hover keeps EdgePilot discreet. Always visible keeps it open. Hidden removes it from the edge until you reopen it from the tray or settings.
monitor.pageSubtitle: Choose which System module data should appear in the notch.
monitor.metricsDescription: Click the whole card to enable or disable a metric. The notch resizes automatically.
metric.disk.description: Used space on the selected volume
monitor.diskDescription: This option appears only while the Disk metric is enabled. EdgePilot still keeps your selection if you temporarily disable it.
behavior.pageSubtitle: Control refresh frequency and how easily EdgePilot reacts to the screen edge.
behavior.refreshDescription: A shorter interval makes values more responsive. A longer interval slightly reduces background work.
behavior.sensitivityDescription: Precise requires getting close to the tab. Wide creates a larger activation zone. Normal is the recommended balance.
startup.pageSubtitle: Choose how EdgePilot enters your session and when it should shut down completely.
startup.autostartDescription: Enable startup for the current user. EdgePilot will remain available without being launched manually after every sign-in.
startup.autostartLabel: Start EdgePilot when I sign in
startup.sessionDescription: Completely closes EdgePilot, including the panel and background process.
about.pageSubtitle: The project, who builds it, and the people who made substantial contributions.
about.productDescription: An edge-native desktop surface for Windows and Linux, designed to surface information and actions only when they matter.
about.authorDescription: EdgePilot is an independent open-source project. Product direction, development, and primary maintenance are led by @pricootz, with community contributions through GitHub.
about.contributorsDescription: People who made substantial contributions to EdgePilot's public foundations.
about.arnieRole: Glass (Mica/Acrylic), localization architecture, translator workflow, and Spanish localization.
about.iamarayelRole: Initial localization foundation and the first interface translations.
about.localDescription: No account, no required cloud backend, and no telemetry uploader.
about.edgeNativeDescription: EdgePilot lives on the screen edge and aims to reduce traditional windows, dashboards, and notifications.
about.evolvingDescription: The current preview starts with system monitoring; upcoming modules will expand the idea without turning it into a generic dashboard.
about.versionDescription: Preview under active development. APIs, layout, and some features may still change before the first stable release.
tooltip.retryNext: Will retry on the next update.
general.surfaceDescription: Choose EdgePilot's visual material. Flat uses solid surfaces; Mica blends with the desktop; Acrylic uses live blur. Where supported, the same material coordinates the notch and Settings window.
